<h1 id="edimmu" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Edimmu</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Edimmu </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107277567008922.png?v=1" alt="Edimmu" title="Edimmu" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are undead slayer monster requiring 90 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and 115 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1" alt="dungeoneering" title="dungeoneering" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to kill. They are a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>task-only</nowiki></strong><nowiki> monster so players going for the Daemonheim log are strongly advised to prioritise picking this monster whenever </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1" alt="slayercape" title="slayercape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> procs. The player can only access the Edimmu area if on a slayer task or holding slayer wildcards.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Besides the default Edimmu tasks, you can also kill Edimmu for the following tasks:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Creatures of Daemonheim</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ghosts</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zombies</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~585 (530 AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~515K (466K AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Edimmu are slayer monsters found within the Edimmu dungeon, which is located in the Meilyr district of Prifddinas and requires 115 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947795541143632.png?v=1" alt="dungeoneering" title="dungeoneering" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to be assessed. The best way to get there would be the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1" alt="dgcape" title="dgcape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> teleport straight to the dungeon, or by teleporting to the Meilyr district via a teleport seed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-strategy"><ins><nowiki>General strategy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Despite looking large, Edimmus are 1x1, with Elites being 2x2. This makes it viable to use strategies which involve stacking them up and then AoEing them down.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For both active and AFK methods, position your cannon as shown below.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If AFKing, stand in the position as shown below.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/diLpe7Xnjz.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-jacquelyn-tasks"><ins><nowiki>Method: Jacquelyn tasks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If going for pet, as each slayer task forces an Elite spawn, a good way to farm Elites is via the slayer master Jacquelyn. This is done by killing Edimmu during a Zombie or Ghost task which forces an Elite spawn every 15 kills with slayer introspection.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-active-ranged"><ins><nowiki>Method: Active Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<blockquote><nowiki>
</nowiki><h2 id="disclaimer"><nowiki>⚠️ Disclaimer</nowiki></h2><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>This method may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026</nowiki></strong></p><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#suggestions</nowiki></span><nowiki>!</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></blockquote>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The active strategy for Edimmu involves aggroing as many as possible, luring them to a barrier and then chinning them down. This method also works with melee if using a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159341322240.png?v=1" alt="noxscythe" title="noxscythe" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, but ranged has a much easier experience. Additionally, less damage is taken using ranged as Edimmus primarily attack with magic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Generally this method is only recommended for relatively ungeared players, as players with good magic equipment can AFK the task obtaining a slightly lower kph.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The kph of killing Edimmu actively is highly limited by their slow spawn timers.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=1QskhDlXvb7BMjnvTpfW <nowiki>Ranged - Active</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F1QskhDlXvb7BMjnvTpfW.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy"><nowiki>Strategy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When a bunch of Edimmu are aggro'd onto you, step behind the barrier and wait for the Edimmu to fill in the space immediately before the barrier.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When Edimmus are in position, immediately enter to avoid losing Edimmu aggression and target the center Edimmu.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rough ability priority with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is easier to target the normal Edimmu around the Elite and chin them down together.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513195712201228289.png?v=1" alt="Yak" title="Yak" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be a viable familiar for this task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Store some food it in case you mess up Elite Edimmu spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use it to store rare drop table drops, sharks, or unstackable drops (e.g. crystal seeds).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Winter Storage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540068163895347.png?v=1" alt="yakscroll" title="yakscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to bank untradeable drops like attuned crystal weapon/armour seeds or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1015699014764728492.png?v=1" alt="bloodnecklaceshard" title="bloodnecklaceshard" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ While waiting for Edimmu to respawn, you can run around to aggro and kill stray Edimmu not tagged by the cannon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153635004447.png?v=1" alt="ricocaroming" title="ricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/909338509234569216.png?v=1" alt="aggression" title="aggression" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are good options for mass-aggroing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If done right, you will be able to kill at least 585 per hour.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This will vary a little depending on the number of Elite spawns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not needed for the method to work well.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="video-example"><nowiki>Video Example </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/5XFZDdfoRjA <nowiki>Ranged - Active</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-magic"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<blockquote><nowiki>
</nowiki><h2 id="disclaimer_1"><nowiki>⚠️ Disclaimer</nowiki></h2><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>This method may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026</nowiki></strong></p><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#suggestions</nowiki></span><nowiki>!</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></blockquote>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Edimmu are best AFK'd using a staff with caroming </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159294922753.png?v=1" alt="noxstaff" title="noxstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/791281588792590336.png?v=1" alt="caroming4" title="caroming4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> along with gchain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. The gear required strongly depends on the player's effort in dealing with Elite Edimmu. Even though Edimmu themselves do not deal much damage and can be out healed with mage's AoE easily, Elites pose a huge problem if trying to AFK with subpar gear and will require the player to click back and take measures to kill the Elite (e.g. laying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, eating food).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<h2 id="method-afk-necro"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Necro </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="strategy_2"><nowiki>Strategy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Although this method can consistently work completely AFK, the only KO potential is with Elite Edimmu so it is recommended to set up an alt1 alert to ensure safety.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This setup achieves around 500-550kph.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1" alt="superprayerrenewal" title="superprayerrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1" alt="ancientshard" title="ancientshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Alternatively, sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1" alt="holyscarab" title="holyscarab" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1" alt="superprayerrenewal" title="superprayerrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653062565907.png?v=1" alt="penanceaura" title="penanceaura" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1" alt="ancientshard" title="ancientshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary (will result in fewer kills)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1" alt="superprayerrenewal" title="superprayerrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Have your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofful" title="scriptureofful" kind="icon" /><nowiki> turned </nowiki><strong><nowiki>on</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410226484301925.png?v=1" alt="kalgpouch" title="kalgpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409588954923049.png?v=1" alt="kalgscroll" title="kalgscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and set auto fire rate to 1</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
